item.title: 24/7 DAB+ availability in the new year ! | Radio 4 Brainport
item.description: So now you are able to hear us also during the evening and night hours in digital quality over the air. Haven't tuned your DAB+ receiver to our station yet ? Just perform an 'autoscan' to add the local stations like Studio040, Glow FM and also Radio 4 Brainport to the stationlist !

item.title: Switch to DAB+ after AM 828 closedown | Radio 4 Brainport
item.description: Now that our AM service on 828 has closed down on June 30th, this might be a good moment to switch to DAB+ listening if you want to receive Radio 4 Brainport over the air. Sure, you can also switch to our 747 kHz AM frequency, especially when you don’t have a DAB+ receiver yet, … Continue reading "Switch to DAB+ after AM 828 closedown"

item.title: DAB+ coverage area increase | Radio 4 Brainport
item.description: Recently the coverage area of the DAB+ 4 Brainport ensemble has been increased. A second transmitter has been powered up and the antenna direction of the first one has been changed to reach as many listeners as possible. You can check your changes of reception using an interactive map .

item.title: New low bit rate AAC stream for mobile devices | Radio 4 Brainport
item.description: As more and more mobile devices are used to listen to audio, both podcasts and live radio, we have added a new low bitrate AAC stream so you can continue to listen to Radio 4 Brainport on your mobile device, e.g. when away from our coverage area.
